title: The ZPA API from a client's side: paths, authentication, paging, limits and wire notes
aliases: how to call the zpa api

prose.text: Endpoint lists, request and response schemas, and SDK method tables are generated from the OpenAPI specification and the SDKs: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface <query>`. This subject family holds only the behavior around them.

prose.label: Calling the API.
prose.text: Hosts, the `/zpa` prefix and API versions are in [[zpa.api.base-paths]], signing in in [[zpa.api.authentication]], paging and search in [[zpa.api.pagination]], and limits in [[zpa.api.rate-limits]]. Whether a write needs an activation step is in [[zpa.api.activation]]. Which services each SDK covers is in [[zpa.api.sdk-coverage]], operations the Automate contract lacks are in [[zpa.api.operation-inventory]], and the older endpoints still in use are in [[zpa.api.legacy-endpoints]].

prose.label: Wire notes by area.
prose.text: Application segments: [[zpa.api.app-segments-wire]]. Server groups: [[zpa.api.server-groups-wire]]. App Connectors: [[zpa.api.app-connectors-wire]]; Private Service Edges: [[zpa.api.service-edges-wire]]; provisioning keys: [[zpa.api.provisioning-keys-wire]]. Policy: [[zpa.api.policy-wire]]. Identity: [[zpa.api.idp-scim-wire]]; posture and trusted networks: [[zpa.api.posture-trusted-networks-wire]]; client settings: [[zpa.api.client-settings-wire]]; machine groups: [[zpa.api.machine-groups-wire]]. Certificates: [[zpa.api.certificates-wire]]. Privileged Remote Access: [[zpa.api.pra-wire]]; Cloud Browser Isolation and AppProtection: [[zpa.api.cbi-appprotection-wire]]. Log receivers: [[zpa.api.lss-wire]]. Microtenants: [[zpa.api.microtenants-wire]].

prose.label: Clients.
prose.text: How the Python and Go SDKs behave is in [[zpa.sdk-python]], and the Terraform provider in [[zpa.terraform]].
